decided: The step that checks whether decision records make sense to a reader runs by default in every system review of a change that has records to read; no setting turns it on or off.
alternatives: a project setting, off by default, so that orbit behaves exactly as before unless the user turns the check on
why: The user chose to relax G0 here: orbit has one user today, and future users are better served by records that are always checked than by a check they must know to enable.
